# Curriculum Differentiation Document

**Purpose:** This document establishes the structural and content differentiation between the SAP internal training curriculum and the public Future of Product Marketing Academy curriculum.

**Date:** July 11, 2026

---

## SAP Internal Training Curriculum (8 Units)

| Unit | Title |
|------|-------|
| 1 | The Evolution of PMM |
| 2 | Visibility in the Age of Agents |
| 3 | Market Intelligence & Competitive Strategy |
| 4 | Winning Satisfiers — Agents & Analysts |
| 5 | Sales Enablement and the Death of the Static Battlecard |
| 6 | Content, Thought Leadership, and the Narrative Advantage |
| 7 | The Demo Stack — Product Storytelling Reimagined |
| 8 | Pricing & Packaging in the Agent Era |

**Platform:** SAP SuccessFactors Learning
**Format:** SCORM 1.2 Package
**Audience:** SAP Internal Learning Team

---

## Future of Product Marketing Academy (12 Units)

| Unit | Title |
|------|-------|
| 1 | The AI-Augmented PMM |
| 2 | Messaging & Positioning in the AI Era |
| 3 | Competitive Intelligence & AI |
| 4 | Winning Evaluators: Analysts & AI Agents |
| 5 | Sales Enablement & the Intelligence Layer |
| 6 | AI-Powered Product Launches |
| 7 | Market Research & Customer Insights |
| 8 | Pricing & Packaging |
| 9 | Content Strategy |
| 10 | Demand Generation Integration |
| 11 | AI Tools & Workflows |
| 12 | Capstone & Career Strategy |

**Platform:** futureofproductmarketing.com
**Format:** Web-based learning platform
**Audience:** Public/Commercial

---

## Structural Differentiation

| Aspect | SAP Curriculum | Public Academy |
|--------|----------------|----------------|
| **Unit Count** | 8 units | 12 units |
| **Topic Organization** | Combined topics | Granular topics |
| **Demo/Storytelling** | Standalone unit (7) | Integrated into other units |
| **Content Strategy** | Merged with Thought Leadership (6) | Standalone unit (9) |
| **Demand Generation** | Not standalone | Standalone unit (10) |
| **AI Tools** | Integrated throughout | Standalone unit (11) |
| **Capstone/Career** | Not included | Standalone unit (12) |
| **Market Research** | Integrated into Unit 3 | Standalone unit (7) |
| **Launches** | Not standalone | Standalone unit (6) |

---

## Title Differentiation

No unit titles are identical between the two curricula:

- SAP uses "Evolution" vs Public uses "AI-Augmented"
- SAP uses "Visibility in the Age of Agents" vs Public uses "Messaging & Positioning"
- SAP uses "Winning Satisfiers" vs Public uses "Winning Evaluators"
- SAP uses "Death of the Static Battlecard" vs Public uses "Intelligence Layer"
- SAP uses "Narrative Advantage" vs Public uses standalone "Content Strategy"
- SAP includes "Demo Stack" which has no public equivalent unit
- Public includes "Capstone & Career Strategy" which has no SAP equivalent

---

## Content Flow Differentiation

**SAP 8-Unit Flow:**
Foundations → Agent Visibility → Competitive → Analysts → Enablement → Content/Narrative → Demos → Pricing

**Public 12-Unit Flow:**
Foundations → Messaging → Competitive → Analysts → Enablement → Launches → Research → Pricing → Content → Demand Gen → AI Tools → Capstone

The curricula follow different pedagogical progressions and topic sequences.

---

## Conclusion

These two curricula represent distinct educational products with:
- Different structural organization (8 vs 12 units)
- Different topic boundaries and groupings
- Different unit titles throughout
- Different pedagogical flow and progression
- Different target audiences and platforms
